text.p: Mariner Health Group Inc said on Friday it has acquired Allegis Health Services Inc, a privately held provider of post acute services.

Based in Calverton, Maryland, Allegis owned five and leased three freestanding skilled nursing facilities and managed three hospital-based skilled nursing units located in the Baltimore/Washington metropolitan area, Mariner said.
Revenues for Allegis in the 12 month period ended May 1996 totaled $68.7 million.
This transaction expands Mariner Health's overall base of operations to 78 inpatient centers with 10,261 beds and 57 outpatient clinics, Mariner said.
Mariner also said it acquired a 163-bed skilled nursing facility in Jacksonville, Florida.
